001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.eventmanager;
002
003import org.bukkit.event.Event;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
006
007import java.util.function.Consumer;
008
009/**
010 * QuickEventManager allow user switch between bukkit and quickshop. QuickShop's EventManager can
011 * filter the Plugin listeners and skip it when calling events
012 */
013public interface QuickEventManager {
014
015  /**
016   * Calling an event use QuickShopEventManager
017   *
018   * @param event The event
019   *
020   * @throws IllegalStateException Just like bukkit
021   */
022  void callEvent(@NotNull Event event, @Nullable Consumer<Event> callBeforePassToMonitor) throws IllegalStateException;
023}
